title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1982-09-21
lineage: Dat (Sony D8) -> CD (Tascam CDRW700) -> Samplitude Professional v7.02 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: High‑fidelity soundboard capture of a uniquely sequenced set with a sweet Touch > Samson, praised for its clean mix and flawless performance.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about both the musical flow and the pristine recording. The show is highlighted for its eclectic first‑set song choices and the standout Touch > Samson transition, while the soundboard source delivers a clear, high‑end‑emphasized mix that many call "perfect" or "excellent."

ai_rating.rationale: All four reviewers give 4–5 stars and consistently praise both performance and audio quality, indicating a strong show with an excellent soundboard recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clean, clear mix with emphasized high‑end frequencies; no reported dropouts or muddiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Unique and varied first‑set selection praised by fans; overall flow described as perfect and highly enjoyable.
